systems.owner: Sudan Police, General Administration for Public Service Complexes
systems.tiers: Omdurman and Bahri complexes working in full, Khartoum complex to reopen in part; hosts ten national departments including passports, civil registry, traffic and customs

note: The complexes are service centres run by the national police for passports, civil registry, traffic and customs; they are out of scope as a national agency's own offices, and no local government office is named.
